# Game Pitch: [Title]

Adapted from the ChatGPT Game Studios pitch template. This optional aid presents
the developer's selected concept to an identified audience. It creates no workflow
gate and does not author or replace `design/gdd/CONCEPT.md`.

- Audience and purpose: [feedback, collaboration, funding or other selected use].
- State, author and revision: [draft / approved for the identified use; actual values].
- Basis: [developer CONCEPT revision and relevant supporting documents].
- Publication state: [internal draft / explicitly authorized delivery and actual record].

Retain applicable sections. Mark unsettled decisions and evidence gaps explicitly.
Distinguish intended features, implemented work and observed results. Examples and
aspirations must not become factual claims. Publication requires its own authorization.
